advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm emitting the per-fold timing line at WARNING on every fold (not just slow/anomalous ones) is the intended operational level, or gate it behind a duration threshold / INFO.
evidence: Docstring at compact_txn.py:415-417 states WARNING was chosen deliberately 'the level every entrypoint's handler shows by default' so it reaches production logs — i.e. unconditional per-fold emission is intended.
report() is called in the outer `finally` of _compact_locked (compact_txn.py:566-567), so it fires for every invocation regardless of outcome.
advisory.finding: Every compaction fold, including routine fast and healthy ones, now logs a WARNING-level line unconditionally via _FoldTimer.report(). On a 300k-ticket store a full sweep folds many tickets, so steady-state operation will emit a WARNING per fold, which can swamp real warnings in logs/alerting that treat WARNING as actionable.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Compute `key = _signer_key(ev)` once in preresolve_signers and reuse it for both the membership test and the insert.
evidence: src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py:167: if ev.get("author_sig") and _signer_key(ev) not in signers:
advisory.finding: preresolve_signers recomputes _signer_key(ev) twice on the same event in the membership-check-then-insert line, calling ev.get() redundantly.
advisory.suggested_fix: key = _signer_key(ev); if ev.get("author_sig") and key not in signers: signers[key] = _identify_signer(ev, repo_root)

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test distinguishing a present-but-None presolved signer entry (no in-lock re-lookup) from an absent key (in-lock fallback) in _build_authorship_ledger.
evidence: compact_txn.py:210: `signer_pubkey = signers[key] if key in signers else _identify_signer(ev, repo_root)`
preresolve_signers stores None for failed lookups (compact_txn.py:168 `signers[_signer_key(ev)] = _identify_signer(ev, repo_root)`), so a present-None key skips the in-lock fallback

test_a_signer_missing_from_the_presolved_map_is_still_looked_up drops the key entirely (`partial = {k: v for k, v in signers.items() if k != dropped}`), exercising only the absent-key branch; no test supplies a present-None entry
advisory.finding: The in-lock signer fallback is tested only for a key ABSENT from the presolved map; the present-but-None case (prelock lookup recorded null, so `key in signers` is True and no in-lock re-lookup occurs) is untested, leaving the two distinct added branches of `signers[key] if key in signers else _identify_signer(...)` under-distinguished.
scenarios: A prelock signer lookup that returns None (decode/lookup failure) — the ledger records null rather than retrying under the lock; no test asserts which behavior is intended.
